acceptance_criteria: summary()['attention'] is derived from open records by the stated precedence; stored status no longer decides the headline except owner-set done/dropped
a regression test reproduces the dogfood defect: every question resolved, a missing_capability blocker open, stored status 'waiting' -> attention is 'blocked', never needs_you
tests cover each precedence step and owner-approval items counting as needs_you
web/alpha.js labels cards and the sheet from attention; no other UI change
prohibited_actions: deploy, promote to production, restart services or change systemd/launchd/watchers
read, add or change secrets, credentials or tokens
Shopify, Gmail, Stripe or any other business write, or any external send
change reviewer principals, owner authority, permissions or connector/MCP access
destructive repository cleanup or history rewriting
change the frozen engineering lifecycle kernel
requested_outcome: Real mobile dogfood defect (objective obj_d1d12ba8, 2026-09-23): after George's answers resolved every open question, the phone card still said 'WAITING ON YOU' while nothing needed him, because Objective.summary() in app/objectives/store.py reports the stored status field and web/alpha.js labels the card from it. Derive the headline from the open records instead, one rule used everywhere: needs_you when an open owner question exists or a proposed item needing the owner awaits approval; otherwise blocked when an open blocker exists; otherwise doing when an item is started; otherwise idle. Owner-set done and dropped stay as set. Expose it as summary()['attention'] with summary()['attention_reason'] (one short line naming the record that decided it), keep 'status' for compatibility, and make the card and sheet in web/alpha.js use attention for the label. Nothing else changes.
title: Unified Derived Truth + Attention Semantics V1
